name: Fruit Bonanza · V2 MUSIC
description: AI-AUDIO VARIANT of fruit-bonanza. Identical 6x5 tumble-slot gameplay (Sweet Bonanza style), with the procedural Web-Audio shim replaced by ElevenLabs-generated MP3 samples: 6 SFX (pop / drop / chime / bomb / fanfare / spin) + a 20s ambient casino loop as background music (BGM). Audio buffers decoded once on preload; BGM auto-starts on the first user gesture (browser autoplay policy). Mute button (♪/✕) and the `M` hotkey still work.
